Read-only Lean checks confirm the finite-stage route compiles and does not need an injectivity theorem.

The exact atlas identity is:

```lean
theorem transition_comp_restrictionLeft_eq_restrictionRight
    (U V : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex C) :
    (pic0FiniteStageTransition C (U, V)).comp
        (pic0FiniteStageRestrictionLeft C V U) =
      pic0FiniteStageRestrictionRight C U V := by
  apply DFunLike.ext _ _
  intro x
  let J := (pic0_sepClosed_representableBy (C := C)).1
  letI : J.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := ⟨J.hom⟩
  let h₁ : V.1.1 ⊓ U.1.1 ≤ V.1.1 :=
    pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_left C V U
  let h₂ : U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1 ≤ V.1.1 ⊓ U.1.1 := by rw [inf_comm]
  let h₃ : U.1.1 ⊓ V.1.1 ≤ V.1.1 :=
    pic0FiniteStageAffineOverlap_le_right C U V
  change (J.left.resHom h₂) ((J.left.resHom h₁) x) =
    (J.left.resHom h₃) x
  calc
    _ = (J.left.resHom (h₂.trans h₁)) x :=
      Scheme.resHom_resHom h₁ h₂ x
    _ = (J.left.resHom h₃) x := by rfl
```

The transported ambient-map equality also compiles. Its proof is just conjugation of that result through `P.e`; after cancelling
`(P.e (Sum.inr (V, U))).apply_symm_apply`, use:

```lean
exact congrArg (P.e (Sum.inr (U, V))).symm
  (DFunLike.congr_fun hExact ((P.e (Sum.inl V)) x))
```

Then the exact M-stage reflection skeleton compiled:

```lean
have hM :
    (P.mapM (Sum.inr (U, V))).comp
        (P.mapM (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (V, U)))) =
      P.mapM (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (U, V))) := by
  apply DatG0.tensorProduct_algHom_comp_eq_of_baseChange P.M
    (P.mapM (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (V, U))))
    (P.mapM (Sum.inr (U, V)))
    (P.mapM (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (U, V))))
    (pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.e
      (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (V, U))))
    (pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.e
      (Sum.inr (U, V)))
    (pic0FiniteStageTransportedMap C P.L P.n P.m P.relation P.e
      (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (U, V))))
  · exact P.hmapM _
  · exact P.hmapM _
  · exact P.hmapM _
  · exact hTransported
```

Finally the N-stage equality compiled:

```lean
change
  (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := P.M.1) (K := P.N.1)
    (P.mapM (Sum.inr (U, V)))).comp
    (AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := P.M.1) (K := P.N.1)
      (P.mapM (Sum.inl (Sum.inl (V, U))))) =
  AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom (R := P.M.1) (K := P.N.1)
    (P.mapM (Sum.inl (Sum.inr (U, V))))
rw [AlgebraicJacobian.scalarExtensionMapOfAlgHom_comp, hM]
```

Thus the current direct `rightRestrictionBaseChangeAlgHom` is now compatible with `D0.snd`, provided this three-stage lemma is added. The earlier generic injectivity result would require `[Module.Flat R K]` plus importing `Mathlib.RingTheory.Flat.Basic`; it is unnecessary here, and no `FaithfulSMul` assumption is needed.

1	/-

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageRestrictionBaseChange
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# The overlap component of finite-stage Picard base change
    10	
    11	The overlaps produced by `Scheme.Pullback.gluing` are nested pullbacks. We first
    12	flatten that categorical presentation, using the certified pullback presentation of
    13	the original overlap, and then apply the existing affine overlap comparison.
    14	-/
    15	
    16	set_option autoImplicit false
    17	
    18	universe u
    19	
    20	open CategoryTheory Limits TensorProduct
    21	open scoped TensorProduct
    22	
    23	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    24	
    25	noncomputable section
    26	
    27	/-- Flatten the nested pullback obtained by first base-changing `U` and then
    28	intersecting it with `V`. The only input about `W` is its displayed pullback
    29	presentation as `U ×_X V`. -/
    30	noncomputable def nestedPullbackFlatteningIso
    31	    {U V X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    32	    (iU : U ⟶ X) (iV : V ⟶ X) (f : X ⟶ Z) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    33	    (a : W ⟶ U) (b : W ⟶ V)
    34	    (hab : a ≫ iU = b ≫ iV)
    35	    (hW : IsLimit (PullbackCone.mk a b hab)) :
    36	    pullback (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV ≅
    37	      pullback (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g := by
    38	  let e : W ≅ pullback iU iV :=
    39	    hW.conePointUniqueUpToIso (pullback.isLimit iU iV)
    40	  have e_inv_fst : e.inv ≫ a = pullback.fst iU iV := by
    41	    change e.inv ≫ (PullbackCone.mk a b hab).fst = _
    42	    exact IsLimit.conePointUniqueUpToIso_inv_comp hW
    43	      (pullback.isLimit iU iV) WalkingCospan.left
    44	  exact
    45	    asIso (pullback.map
    46	      (pullback.fst (iU ≫ f) g ≫ iU) iV
    47	      (pullback.snd g (iU ≫ f) ≫ iU) iV
    48	      (pullbackSymmetry (iU ≫ f) g).hom (𝟙 V) (𝟙 X)
    49	      (by simp) (by simp)) ≪≫
    50	    pullbackAssoc g (iU ≫ f) iU iV ≪≫
    51	    pullbackSymmetry g (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) ≪≫
    52	    asIso (pullback.map
    53	      (pullback.fst iU iV ≫ (iU ≫ f)) g
    54	      (a ≫ iU ≫ f) g
    55	      e.inv (𝟙 Y) (𝟙 Z)
    56	      (by
    57	        simpa only [Category.comp_id, Category.assoc] using
    58	          congrArg (fun q => q ≫ iU ≫ f) e_inv_fst.symm)
    59	      (by simp))
    60	
    61	end
    62	
    63	end AlgebraicGeometry
